title: Seven weeks with the lake down
subtitle: The Lower Colorado River Authority's Lake Austin drawdown, week by week
alt: Timeline of the Lake Austin drawdown: the Lower Colorado River Authority begins lowering the lake on Oct. 12 at about one foot a day at the City of Austin's request; the lake reaches its target about a dozen feet down after roughly three weeks, with public boat ramps closed and no swimming at Emma Long Metro Park; four weeks of dock cleaning, maintenance and hydrilla management follow; refilling from Lake Travis starts Nov. 24 at two feet a day; and the drawdown period ends Nov. 30
source: City of Austin memo and LCRA schedule, via FOX 7 Austin
